SELECT AVG(d."XCL_029" - d."XCL_028")
FROM district AS d
WHERE d."XCL_019" = 'Prague'

    SELECT 1
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS dp ON c."XCL_009" = dp."XCL_014"
    JOIN card AS cd ON dp."XCL_013" = cd."XCL_006"
    WHERE c."XCL_010" = 'F'

      AND c."XCL_012" = d."XCL_017"
